draft_en.subject: PoE, industrial switches and media converters for the shopdelta range
draft_en.body:
Hello Delta team,

Over the past months you had a few product mails from us - most recently "24 Port PoE Managed Switch" on 1 September 2026 - and there was no reason to answer a mass mail. This one is specific.

For the PoE, industrial and media-converter positions in the shopdelta range, three neutral-brand items from single units, CE/RoHS:

- 8 x Gigabit PoE+ + 2 x SFP, L2+ managed, Marvell-based - model STC-28DGGPM - $80.7 USD EXW (MOQ 1, 15-day validity)
- DIN-rail industrial 8 x Gigabit + 2 x SFP, unmanaged, -40 to 75 C - STI-280GE - $46.6
- industrial mini Gigabit media converter with SFP slot - STI-110GE - $26.5

SFP optics we do not supply.

One question: which of these three do your installer customers reorder most?

Best regards,
Alan
Saga Telecom - sagatele.com
